name: Commerce add to cart confirmation
description: Provides an "add to cart" confirmation screen.
project_description:
This module integrates with Drupal Commerce to provide a richer and extensible "Add to Cart" message.

  

  

 
 Features 
 
 Provides an "add to cart" confirmation dialog, shown after an item is added to the customer's cart. 
 Adds a "Commerce Add to Cart Confirmation" view, which is a richer and more prominent message than the default add to cart message.
 
 The view can be configured, as needed, for a richer experience. For example, you could embed an additional view to display featured or related products.
 
 
 
 
 Drupal 10.3 & 11 / Commerce Add to Cart Confirmation 2.0.0 
 Installation 
 Commerce Add to Cart Confirmation 2.0.0 should only be installed via Composer. The zip files on this page are provided for informative purposes only.

 Drupal 10.3.0 or newer is required.

 
 
 Drupal 9.3 & 10 & 11 / Commerce Add to Cart Confirmation 1.1.0 
 Installation 
 Commerce Add to Cart Confirmation 1.1.0 should only be installed via Composer. The zip files on this page are provided for informative purposes only.

 Drupal 9.3.0 or newer is required.
